title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXII OF 2020
ACT XXXII OF 2020
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA PUBLIC SERVICE
COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
19th August, 2020]
No.
PA/Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-110 / 2020 / 3661, dated 19.8.2020.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission
(Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 7th August, 2020 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 13th August, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS,
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1978 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XI of 1978), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing:
It
is hereby enacted by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service Commission (Amendment)
Act, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

WHEREAS,

Commission Ordinance, 1978 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XI of 1978), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing:
It
is hereby enacted by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 4 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. XI of 1978.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public Service
Commission Ordinance, 1978 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ordinance No. X1 of 1978), in
section 4, in subsection (1),-
(a) for
the word "five", the word "three" shall be substituted; and
(b) for
the existing proviso, the following shall be substituted, namely:
"Provided
that the aforesaid condition shall not be applicable to the existing Chairman
and Members appointed before the commencement of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Public
Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2020".
